story.summaryZh: 🚨达喀尔拉力赛第49届赛事将特别迁至葡萄牙和摩洛哥举行，这是赛事20年来首次重返非洲大陆。🌍2027年FIA世界拉力-越野锦标赛的首场比赛将从1月9日至23日进行，总行程7824公里，包括4341公里的比赛阶段，具体日期需经FIA世界汽车运动理事会批准。
story.originalTitle: 🚨 The Dakar returns to Africa in 2027! 🚨 The 49th edition of the iconic Cross-Country event will be exceptionally relocated to Portugal 🇵🇹...
story.summaryEn:
🚨 The Dakar returns to Africa in 2027! 🚨
The 49th edition of the iconic Cross-Country event will be exceptionally relocated to Portugal 🇵🇹 and Morocco 🇲🇦, marking the event’s first return to the African continent in 20 years.
🌍 The opening round of the 2027 FIA World Rally-Raid Championship will cover 7,824 km, including 4,341 km of competitive stages, from 9–23 January, subject to FIA World Motor Sport Council approval.
#FIA #Dakar2027 #W2RC
